nodes.summary: For a local-exponent family $F$ with local exponents $m_i$ ($i \in \iota$), the set of admissible exponents of $F$ is the set of real numbers $\delta \ge 0$ such that $F$ is admissible at $\delta$, that is, $m_i \le \delta$ for every index $i$.
nodes.title: Admissible exponents of a local-exponent family

nodes.summary: A local-exponent family $F$ with local exponents $m_i$ ($i \in \iota$) dominates the Selberg archimedean slice when, for every congruence subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and every eigenvalue $\lambda$ of the hyperbolic Laplacian on $L^2(\Gamma \backslash \mathbb{H})$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$, there is an index $i$ with $m_i = \sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$.
nodes.title: Families dominating the Selberg exceptional spectrum

nodes.summary: For every local-exponent family $F$ and every index $i$, the local exponent $m_i$ of $F$ at $i$ is at most the Ramanujan exponent of $F$.
nodes.title: Local exponents are bounded by the Ramanujan exponent

nodes.summary: For a local-exponent family $F$ indexed by a type $\iota$, with local exponents $m(i)$ for $i \in \iota$, the exponent set of $F$ is the set of real numbers $\{0\} \cup \{m(i) : i \in \iota\}$.
nodes.title: Exponent set of a local-exponent family

nodes.summary: A local-exponent family $F$ satisfies the Generalized Ramanujan conclusion when every local exponent $m_i$ of $F$ ($i \in \iota$) is zero.
nodes.title: Generalized Ramanujan conjecture for a family

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field, $v$ a finite place of $K$ with residue norm $N(v)$, and $t, \delta$ real numbers with $0 \le t \le \delta$. If complex numbers $\alpha, \beta$ form a Satake pair with local exponent $t$ at residue cardinality $N(v)$, then $|\alpha + \beta| \le 2 N(v)^\delta$.
nodes.title: Hecke bound from a Satake pair at a finite place

nodes.summary: Let $N \ge 1$ and $t, \delta$ be real numbers with $0 \le t \le \delta$. If complex numbers $\alpha, \beta$ form a Satake pair with local exponent $t$ at residue cardinality $N$, then $|\alpha + \beta| \le 2 N^\delta$.
nodes.title: Hecke bound from a Satake pair

nodes.summary: For every local-exponent family $F$ and every real $\delta \ge 0$, $F$ is admissible at $\delta$ if and only if the Ramanujan exponent of $F$ is at most $\delta$.
nodes.title: Admissibility is a bound by the Ramanujan exponent

nodes.summary: For every local-exponent family $F$, $F$ is admissible at its Ramanujan exponent: every local exponent of $F$ is at most the Ramanujan exponent of $F$.
nodes.title: The Ramanujan exponent is admissible

nodes.summary: A local-exponent family $F$ is admissible at a real number $\delta$ (Hypothesis $H_2(\delta)$ for $F$) when every local exponent $m_i$ of $F$ ($i \in \iota$) is at most $\delta$.
nodes.title: Admissibility of an exponent for a local-exponent family

nodes.summary: For real numbers $N$ and $t$, a pair $(\alpha, \beta)$ of complex numbers is in arithmetic Satake normalization with local exponent $t$ at residue cardinality $N$ when $|\alpha\beta| = 1$, $|\alpha| = N^t$ and $|\beta| = N^{-t}$.
nodes.title: Satake pairs with a given local exponent

nodes.summary: A local-exponent family indexed by a type $\iota$ is a function $m : \iota \to \mathbb{R}$, the local Langlands exponents, with $0 \le m(i) \le 1/2$ for every $i \in \iota$.
nodes.title: Family of local exponents

nodes.summary: For every local-exponent family $F$, the Ramanujan exponent of $F$ equals the infimum of the admissible exponents of $F$, that is, of the set of real numbers $\delta \ge 0$ such that every local exponent of $F$ is at most $\delta$.
nodes.title: The Ramanujan exponent is the infimum of the admissible exponents

nodes.summary: For every local-exponent family $F$, the Ramanujan exponent of $F$ is $0$ if and only if $F$ satisfies the generalized Ramanujan conclusion, that is, every local exponent of $F$ is $0$.
nodes.title: The Ramanujan exponent vanishes exactly in the tempered case

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a local-exponent family and let $\delta \ge 0$ be a real number. If $\delta$ is admissible for $F$, that is, every local exponent of $F$ is at most $\delta$, then the Ramanujan exponent of $F$ is at most $\delta$.
nodes.title: Admissible exponents bound the Ramanujan exponent

nodes.summary: The Ramanujan exponent of the canonical Selberg family of archimedean exponents is exactly Selberg's congruence spectral-gap constant.
nodes.title: The Selberg family's exponent is Selberg's constant

nodes.summary: The Ramanujan exponent of a local-exponent family $F$ with local exponents $m(i)$, $i \in \iota$, is the supremum of the set $\{0\} \cup \{m(i) : i \in \iota\}$. It is the supremum of the local exponents when $\iota$ is nonempty, and $0$ when $\iota$ is empty.
nodes.title: Ramanujan exponent of a local-exponent family

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a local-exponent family that dominates the Selberg archimedean slice, that is, for every congruence subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and every Laplace eigenvalue $\lambda \in (0, 1/4)$ of $\Gamma$, the gap $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ is one of the local exponents of $F$. Then Selberg's constant is at most the Ramanujan exponent of $F$.
nodes.title: Selberg's constant is at most every dominating family's exponent

nodes.summary: The Selberg family is the local-exponent family indexed by the exceptional-eigenvalue witnesses, the pairs $(\Gamma, \lambda)$ of a congruence subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and a Laplace eigenvalue $\lambda \in (0, 1/4)$ of $\Gamma$, whose local exponent at $(\Gamma, \lambda)$ is $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$.
nodes.title: Selberg family of archimedean exponents

nodes.summary: For an exceptional-eigenvalue witness, a congruence subgroup $\Gamma$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ with a Laplace eigenvalue $\lambda \in (0, 1/4)$, the Selberg gap is $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$: the archimedean local exponent $\theta$ forced by $\lambda$, written as $\lambda = 1/4 - \theta^2$.
nodes.title: Selberg gap of an exceptional eigenvalue

nodes.summary: The type of pairs $(\Gamma, \lambda)$ where $\Gamma$ is a congruence subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and $\lambda$ is a real eigenvalue of the hyperbolic Laplacian on $L^2(\Gamma \backslash \mathbb{H})$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$.
nodes.title: Exceptional Selberg eigenvalue witnesses

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a local-exponent family that dominates the Selberg archimedean slice. If $\Gamma$ is a congruence subgroup of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and $\lambda$ is a real eigenvalue of the hyperbolic Laplacian on $L^2(\Gamma \backslash \mathbb{H})$ with $0 < \lambda < 1/4$, then $\sqrt{1/4 - \lambda}$ is at most the Ramanujan exponent of $F$.
nodes.title: Exceptional eigenvalues bound Selberg-dominating exponents from below

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
